text: Devagar se vai ao longe. (Slowly, you go far.)
author: Portuguese proverb

text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Lao Tzu

text: Well done is better than well said.
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Água mole em pedra dura, tanto bate até que fura. (Soft water on hard stone, it strikes until it breaks through.)
author: Portuguese proverb

text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: To sail is necessary; to live is not necessary.
author: Pompey, motto of the Portuguese navigators

text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
author: Epictetus

text: The best way out is always through.
author: Robert Frost

text: Quem não arrisca não petisca. (Who doesn't risk, doesn't get a taste.)
author: Portuguese proverb

text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
author: Marie Curie

text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
author: Linus Torvalds

text: Deus ajuda quem cedo madruga. (God helps those who rise early.)
author: Portuguese proverb

text: You miss one hundred percent of the shots you don't take.
author: Wayne Gretzky

text: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
author: Harold Abelson & Gerald Jay Sussman

text: Perfection is achieved not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
author: Japanese proverb

text: Mais vale tarde do que nunca. (Better late than never.)
author: Portuguese proverb

text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Energy and persistence conquer all things.
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: We are what we repeatedly do.
author: Will Durant

text: Amanhã é outro dia. (Tomorrow is another day.)
author: Portuguese saying
